brief: FUEL scoring and TOWER objectives require scheduling around HUB availability.

requirements.fact: AUTO lasts 20 seconds; TELEOP includes transition, alternating alliance shifts and end game.
requirements.design: Keep phase authority external to the mechanism and cancel on mode changes.

requirements.fact: Inactive-HUB FUEL earns no points; availability alternates based on AUTO/FMS outcome.
requirements.design: Conservatively hold feed for unknown/inactive availability; this is a strategy policy, not a claim that inactive-HUB shots are prohibited.

alternatives: Simpler indexing and bounded inventory; more collection cycles.
More storage and burst capacity; jam, packaging and power costs.
Additional scoring role; climb load path and integration effort.
selected: Small-buffer FUEL shooter with external availability gate
rationale: Reuse the flywheel contract while making uncertain scoring-window state explicit. Fixture capacity is one for testing simplicity, not a 2026 possession-rule claim.
subsystems: Acquire from a reviewed route; no full-field routing implemented.
One-pocket fixture with anti-jam timeout; hopper scale-up deferred.
Synthetic speed target plus alignment validity.
Supplies ACTIVE/INACTIVE/UNKNOWN; FMS parsing and flight-time scheduling unimplemented.
risks: No fuel flight, bounce, scoring sensor or full-field model
No FMS parser, phase-clock synchronization or scoring-window arrival-time verification
